build.kind: one-time clean baseline; subsequent checkpoints reuse this tree
build.fingerprint_method: From cde/: find . -type f matching *.c, *.C, *.h, *.am; sort NUL-delimited paths; sha256sum each; sha256sum resulting list

check.focused_regressions: All batch sanitizer regressions passed, including property validation, Trash parsing/write failures, copy completion/paths, session ownership, procfs traversal, terminal bounds, help strings and login environment failures
check.limitations: Existing dtksh leak-test skips remain; this does not establish coverage of every desktop component

checks: Staged executables equal built executables; localized configuration assets equal their generated inputs
All five processes map the pinned prefix's libXm.so.9.0.0
Six native valid/malformed X11 property cases pass against the running dtwm
Command typed through the visible terminal succeeds
Actual File Manager and Terminal screenshots inspected
